CREATE TABLE app_license (
            license_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            license_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            customer_name TEXT NOT NULL,
            product_name TEXT NOT NULL,
            issued_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            expires_at TEXT,
            activated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            device_id TEXT NOT NULL,

CREATE TRIGGER trg_expense_delete_project
            AFTER DELETE ON expenses
            WHEN OLD.project_id IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                UPDATE projects SET
                    expenses=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM expenses WHERE project_id=OLD.project_id),
                    revenue=budget_ht-(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM expenses WHERE project_id=OLD.project_id),
                    "revenue %"=CASE WHEN budget_ht>0 THEN
                        ((budget_ht-(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM expenses WHERE project_id=OLD.project_id))/budget_ht)*100
                        ELSE 0 END,
                    updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                WHERE project_id=OLD.project_id;
            END

concepts.architecture: PySide6 desktop UI + SQLite local database + modular pages/services/repositories/core/theme. Pages own UI, services contain business logic, repositories mediate data access, database owns schema/migrations.
concepts.navigation: MENU in BuildOffice Pro.py defines page order, page class and group. Pages are lazy-loaded by _ensure_page and opened through open_page.
concepts.localization: Central i18n controller and translate_text/localize_widget_tree are used for English/Arabic without application-level RTL.
concepts.themes: ThemeStore, palette/theme modules and QSS build the visual system; settings persist theme and palette selections.
concepts.data_flow: UI page -> repository/service -> SQLite -> analytics/intelligence/reporting -> UI/AI.
concepts.ai_scope: This assistant is read-only by default. It can explain the program, inspect its source/schema, answer live-data questions, connect evidence, and surface affected pages/files. Destructive actions require explicit future command handling.
concepts.financial_workflow: Projects define the contract/budget. Expenses record direct project costs and can reference cost centers/BOQ items. Project payments record money received for a project. Situations and situation_items represent executed quantities and certified work. Analytics/intelligence combine these records for project health, cost, progress and collection risk.
concepts.people_workflow: Staff are master records. Attendance records connect staff to projects and working hours. Labor allocations connect labor hours/cost to projects. Payroll records store payroll calculations. The intelligence/services layer reconciles these sources.
concepts.operations_workflow: Vehicles, fuel_records, maintenance_records and equipment_usage form the fleet/equipment control chain. Materials and material_movements support material tracking. Construction Control and Project Control Center consume operational data for management views.
concepts.documents_workflow: Documents can be attached to company or other owners through owner_type/owner_id. Project documents have dedicated support in the schema, while Document Generation and situation document services handle generated administrative records.
